message.content: {"action":"decrease_precision","reason":"Current evaluated points show phase_bits=16 is the only setting meeting the 8-LSB quality requirement, but it costs 1584.6 um^2. The lower-precision neighbors (14 and 12 bits) fail quality, while 10 bits is smaller but also fails. Since increase_precision and increase_table_capacity have no legal unvisited neighbors, the only available precision move is decrease_precision; this explores a smaller-area direction from the current high-precision region, balancing area reduction against the already-observed quality gap."}
